theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Industrials (+0.17%) and Technology (-0.07%) led the market today, while Energy (-3.00%) and Financials (-1.74%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.53%, defensives -0.30%, and value/cyclicals -1.25% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained -0.01% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -1.21%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.40%. The VIX rose 2.91% to 17.71, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.43% to $4,304.60, crude oil was little changed at $101.99, and bitcoin gained 0.57% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
